body.title: Ollama reviewer session
body.summary: Make runReviewSession an optional member of LLMProvider and implement it on OllamaProvider over the generic loop: repository cwd, read-only allowlist, deadline, signal, and a schema-checked structured answer.
acceptanceChecks: An Ollama reviewer session reads the repository with read-only tools and returns a schema-checked answer within its deadline.

tests.name: src/agent/providers/__tests__/ollama-review-session.test.ts: 'an Ollama reviewer session reads the repo with read-only tools and returns a schema-checked answer within its deadline'
src/agent/providers/__tests__/ollama-review-session.test.ts: 'cancelling an Ollama reviewer session mid tool loop aborts the in-flight turn and starts no further turn'
src/agent/providers/__tests__/ollama-review-session.test.ts: 'a returned file_write or Write call, or any tool outside the read-only allowlist, is refused before dispatch and never executed'
